newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NOL adds four new ships to fleet.
newsitem.headline: NOL adds four new ships to fleet.

text.p: Shipping group Neptune Orient Lines Ltd (NOL) said on Tuesday it had brought two new panamax bulk carriers and two new crude oil tankers into its fleet.
The four vessels were commissioned as part of the fleet's upgrading, NOL said in a statement.
It said the two 73,000-dwt carriers and the two 99,300-dwt tankers were "Christened" on Monday at Samsung Heavy Industries' shipyard in South Korea.
The carriers were expected to be delivered in the first half of 1997.
The two tankers were the second part of a four tanker order. The first two were delivered in July and September. Delivery dates for the second pair were not available.
All four tankers were on long-term charter to Bayway Refining Company, the statement said.
